title: Small Bites from the Digital Onigiri
subtitle: Get updates on YEN's progress directly from the source
html:
Hello!

I’m 8, the only full-time engineer working on YEN, a modern Terminal App for macOS!

It’s quite a lot and in an effort to keep things simple I started this Substack to keep our small community updated with progress, feature releases, and more.

You can also get community support here as well!

What I Really Want and Need

What I want more than anything else is feedback on the product so please feel free to leave thoughts and suggestions here (via comments) or in GitHub!

Or you can check out the chat feature as well. Appreciate the support!

— 8
